description: Eléments topographiques liés aux axes de ruissellement (cuvettes et remblais) sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. This layer complements the layer of runoff axes on Rennes Métropole (UUID = e0fa5c09-ee44-46ff-a068-b6dada575c9f) by topographic analysis. As part of the runoff study currently being conducted by Rennes Métropole (2023-2025), a first analysis of the hydraulic functioning of the territory was carried out at the global scale of its territory. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Topographical elements linked to runoff axes (cuvettes and embankments) on Rennes Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole. Its keywords include classification-de-lusage-des-sols, environnement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2021-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
